Is it on the agreement at the opening? rental_charges for agreement 2f57ff6b… = {c289b337 rental_time_charged weekly ×2 1855.00; edccb4ea rental_time_charged daily ×1 265.00; 3fa16238 rental_inspection_recorded} — no `rental_pro_discount_applied` row. B: class engine_hours_per_day 8 > 0 (metered); hour_meter_in 2332.9 − hour_meter_out 2214.3 = 118.6 hours; B's computation gives 18.6 overtime hours > 0 (below). Is it on the agreement? No `rental_fee_charged` row with `fee_type overtime_hours`. Unmet at the opening. Resolving write: B → `bill_engine_overtime_13bb4269` (owner agent).
A and B carry `prerequisite: []`; their rules carry no prerequisite sentence. Tree closed.
